home.heroTitle: Rehabilitate effectively with {accent} recovery plans and clinical tracking.
home.heroSubtitle: Jolna is a digital physiotherapy platform designed for a Cambodian clinic. We empower physiotherapists to assign custom protocols and track recovery indices while providing patients with daily guided routines.
home.feature1Desc: Create patient profiles, register patients, and assign them directly to designated clinic physiotherapists.
home.feature2Desc: Patients review daily prescribed exercise schedules, watch clinic video tutorials, and report daily completion.
home.feature3Desc: Physiotherapists monitor daily pain progress, logs, and calendar schedules to track patient compliance.
home.aboutDesc1: JOLNA is a specialized physiotherapy rehabilitation platform designed to bridge the gap between physiotherapists and patients. Developed as a capstone project for Paragon International University, JOLNA enables practitioners to design, prescribe, and track personalized recovery routines, while empowering patients with bilingual visual guidance and seamless progress logging.
home.aboutDesc2: Our goal is to make physical rehabilitation accessible, engaging, and measurable. By combining structured exercise schedules with daily pain monitoring, JOLNA provides clinical insight that helps prevent setbacks and supports a safer path back to full mobility.
home.aboutValue1Desc: Fully localized in English and Khmer to support local clinical needs.
home.aboutValue2Desc: Directly link with professional physiotherapists who customize your routine.
home.aboutValue3Desc: Track pain score trends and compliance metrics over time.
